parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group.

parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**
*   **PRE**: the pre-release environment
*   **TEST**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi deploy-api --group-id 63be9002440b4778a61122f14c2b2bbb --api-id d6f679aeb3be4b91b3688e887ca1fe16 --stage-name RELEASE --description for_test1 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DeployApi --region cn-hangzhou --Description for_test1 --StageName RELEASE --ApiId d6f679aeb3be4b91b3688e887ca1fe16 --GroupId 63be9002440b4778a61122f14c2b2bbb
